RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about your denied claim. I've reviewed your case and confirmed that the denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. 

To appeal, your ordering provider (Dr. L. Okonjo) may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. I've made the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) available for your provider to access. 

Your appeal deadline is 180 days from the denial notice date. If you need help with the appeal process or have questions, please don't hesitate to contact me. 

Please let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with. 

Best regards,
ARIA
